#!/usr/bin/env bash
# B1 factory-floor sync worker. Standalone-capable (I5). No root required (I6).
# One-way host->workspace, contents only (A2, A4).
# SRC end state == DST end state, recursive exact mirror (I1).
set -euo pipefail

SRC="${SRC:-${1:-}}"
DST="${DST:-${2:-}}"
DRY_RUN=0
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
  esac
done

usage() { echo "usage: SRC=<path> DST=<path> $0 [--dry-run]"; exit 2; }
[ -n "$SRC" ] && [ -n "$DST" ] || usage
[ -d "$SRC" ] || { echo "SRC not a dir: $SRC" >&2; exit 2; }
mkdir -p "$DST" 2>/dev/null || true
[ -d "$DST" ] || { echo "DST not a dir: $DST" >&2; exit 2; }

# A4: sync CONTENTS (src/ -> dst), no nesting.
SRC_DIR="${SRC%/}/"
DST_DIR="${DST%/}/"

# I3: dry-run => zero writes, incl. logs (all output to stderr only).
hash_dir() {
  # byte-comparable digest of a directory tree (path-relative, content-inclusive)
  ( cd "$1" && find . -type f -print0 | LC_ALL=C sort -z \
      | xargs -0 -r sha256sum -- ) | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
}

if [ "$DRY_RUN" = 1 ]; then
  pre_src="$(hash_dir "$SRC_DIR")"
  pre_dst="$(hash_dir "$DST_DIR")"
  echo "[dry-run] SRC=$pre_src DST=$pre_dst" >&2
  if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rsync -a --delete --dry-run --out-format='%n%L' "$SRC_DIR" "$DST_DIR" >&2 || true
  else
    echo "[dry-run] rsync unavailable; fallback (cp -a) planned" >&2
  fi
  post_dst="$(hash_dir "$DST_DIR")"
  if [ "$pre_dst" != "$post_dst" ]; then
    echo "DRY-RUN VIOLATION: DST changed (I3)" >&2; exit 1
  fi
  echo "[dry-run] zero writes confirmed (I3)" >&2
  exit 0
fi

# Real run: exact mirror (I1) — rsync preferred; cp -a fallback reconciles
# identically incl. subtree prune (no_resurrect: S4-top-level-only-prune).
if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rsync -a --delete "$SRC_DIR" "$DST_DIR"
else
  # cp -a fallback: full prune via temp dir, then atomic-ish swap-in of contents.
  tmp="$(mktemp -d "${DST_DIR%/}.tmp.XXXXXX")"
  cp -a "$SRC_DIR"/. "$tmp"/
  find "$DST_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf -- {} +
  cp -a "$tmp"/. "$DST_DIR"/
  rm -rf "$tmp"
fi

# gate: byte-compare DST vs SRC after real run
h_src="$(hash_dir "$SRC_DIR")"
h_dst="$(hash_dir "$DST_DIR")"
if [ "$h_src" != "$h_dst" ]; then
  echo "GATE FAIL: DST != SRC after sync" >&2; exit 1
fi
echo "[ok] mirrored $SRC_DIR -> $DST_DIR (sha256=$h_src)" >&2
